name: Motorisation
short_description: Trucks for your infantry, no combat changes.
description: Builds enough truck production to move infantry by vehicle. Unlocks the motorised toggle in the division builder for eligible unit types. This is a strategic map speed upgrade only, it changes nothing on the 5x5 combat grid.

name: Uranium Research Program
short_description: One-time science windfall, requires uranium access.
description: Directs national research effort toward uranium's non-nuclear applications. Requires nonzero uranium stock to pay off — a nation with no uranium access completes this node with no bonus. Not a weapon, a one-time research-currency injection (see RESOURCE_ECONOMY.md's Uranium section).
